prompt.zh: 如果明天可以少一件生活小麻煩，你會選哪個？
prompt.en: If tomorrow could remove one small everyday hassle, which would you choose?

prompt.zh: 你可以讓一件家事永遠自動完成。
prompt.en: You can make one chore finish itself forever.

prompt.zh: 這個週末，你只能選一種恢復方式。
prompt.en: This weekend, you get only one way to recover.

prompt.zh: 你可以消除一個日常壓力。
prompt.en: You can erase one everyday pressure.

prompt.zh: 如果手機今晚會公開一個秘密，你比較不想被公開哪個？
prompt.en: If your phone exposed one secret tonight, which would you least want revealed?

prompt.zh: 朋友群只能保留一種美德，你選哪個？
prompt.en: Your friend group can keep only one virtue. Which do you choose?

options.en: Being willing to tell the truth

prompt.zh: 如果今天必須少一種社交能力，你寧可失去哪個？
prompt.en: If you had to lose one social skill today, which would you rather lose?

prompt.zh: 公司新增一個福利，你選哪個？
prompt.en: Your company offers one new perk. Which do you pick?

prompt.zh: 明天早上有會議，今晚你最想獲得哪個祝福？
prompt.en: There is a meeting tomorrow morning. Pick one blessing for tonight.

prompt.zh: 朋友遲到 40 分鐘，你最可能怎麼做？
prompt.en: A friend is 40 minutes late. What are you most likely to do?

prompt.zh: 你可以擁有一個小小超能力。
prompt.en: You can have one tiny superpower.

prompt.zh: 你可以自動化一件家事。
prompt.en: You can automate one chore.

prompt.zh: 如果有一個 App 會誠實評價你的人生狀態，你最怕它顯示什麼？
prompt.en: If an app honestly rated your life status, what result would scare you most?

options.zh: 你比想像中還在意別人
options.en: You care more than you admit

prompt.zh: 如果今晚每個人都要公開一個小缺點，哪種最容易被原諒？
prompt.en: If everyone had to reveal one small flaw tonight, which is easiest to forgive?

prompt.zh: 如果朋友群要立一條新憲法，第一條應該是什麼？
prompt.en: If your friend group wrote a constitution, what should Article One be?

options.en: Arguments must be resolved the same day

prompt.zh: 如果可以偷看大家對你的第一印象，你最想知道哪一項？
prompt.en: If you could see everyone's first impression of you, what would you want to know?

options.en: Whether I seem easy to get along with

prompt.zh: 如果這群人是一個冒險小隊，最可能缺少哪種人？
prompt.en: If this group were an adventure squad, what kind of person would it most likely be missing?

options.zh: 負責把大家拉回現實的人
options.en: Someone who brings everyone back to reality

prompt.zh: 如果大家一起合租，最可能先引爆衝突的是什麼？
prompt.en: If everyone shared a place, what would most likely cause the first conflict?

options.en: Nobody wants to take out the trash

options.zh: 冰箱裡的食物歸屬不明
options.en: Unclear ownership of food in the fridge
Someone stays up too late and makes noise

prompt.zh: 第一次見面時，你最容易被哪種人吸引注意？
prompt.en: When meeting someone for the first time, who most easily catches your attention?

options.en: Someone with a strange sense of humor

prompt.zh: 如果朋友的另一半第一次加入聚會，最加分的是什麼？
prompt.en: If a friend's partner joins the hangout for the first time, what is the biggest plus?

options.zh: 不刻意表現但很有禮貌
options.en: Being polite without trying too hard
Having their own sense of humor

prompt.zh: 你覺得最容易讓人誤會成曖昧的行為是？
prompt.en: What behavior is most easily mistaken for flirting?

prompt.zh: 如果要判斷一個人適不適合交往，你最看重哪個瞬間？
prompt.en: When judging whether someone is good relationship material, which moment matters most?

options.en: How they react when plans fall apart

prompt.zh: 如果人生可以開一個外掛，你最想要哪一種？
prompt.en: If life allowed one cheat code, which would you want most?

options.zh: 永遠知道別人的真實想法
options.en: Always know what people really think

options.zh: 所有選擇都能預覽後果
options.en: Preview the outcome of every choice

options.zh: 想認真時就能立刻進入狀態
options.en: Enter focus mode whenever you want

prompt.zh: 你最希望旅伴在旅途中具備哪種能力？
prompt.en: What ability would you most want in a travel companion?

options.en: Finding the way and handling surprises
Finding good food and fun places

options.zh: 讓大家累的時候不要吵起來
options.en: Keeping everyone from fighting when tired

prompt.zh: 如果只能選一種旅行風格，你會選哪個？
prompt.en: If you could choose only one travel style, which would it be?

options.en: A packed schedule feels worth it

options.zh: 每天只排一件大事，其他隨緣
options.en: One main plan per day, then go with the flow
Do little research and decide after arriving

prompt.zh: 如果家人聚會要變得更舒服，最需要減少什麼？
prompt.en: For family gatherings to feel more comfortable, what needs to be reduced most?

options.zh: 一直問近況和人生計畫
誰要負責收拾的模糊地帶
options.en: The unclear question of who cleans up

prompt.zh: 如果這個房間突然變成一個真人實境節目，節目名稱最像哪個？
prompt.en: If this room suddenly became a reality show, what would the title be?

options.en: Who Is Steering the Room Today?

options.zh: 大家都說沒有但其實都有事
options.en: Everyone Says Nothing Is Going On

prompt.zh: 如果要在這場遊戲裡隱藏自己的真實目的，最有效的方法是？
prompt.en: What is the most effective way to hide your real motive in this game?

options.en: Make it sound like a sincere opinion
Laugh along without taking a stance

options.zh: 故意提出一個很合理的假理由
options.en: Offer a very reasonable fake reason

prompt.zh: 如果大家一起準備一頓晚餐，最可能先讓場面失控的是什麼？
prompt.en: If everyone cooked dinner together, what would most likely make things go off the rails first?

options.zh: 有人說要幫忙但只會站著聊天
options.en: Someone says they will help but only stands around chatting

prompt.zh: 如果你要讓大家相信一個很荒謬的故事，最有效的方法是什麼？
prompt.en: If you wanted everyone to believe a ridiculous story, what would work best?

options.en: Tell it with very specific details
Get one person to agree first

options.zh: 假裝這件事其實不重要
options.en: Act like it is not important

prompt.zh: 你覺得真正穩定的關係，最需要哪一種默契？
prompt.en: What kind of unspoken understanding matters most in a truly stable relationship?

options.zh: 知道什麼時候不要追問
options.en: Knowing when not to keep asking

options.zh: 吵架後還願意回來講清楚
options.en: Still being willing to talk after a fight

options.zh: 不用表現完美也不怕被討厭
options.en: Not fearing rejection when you are not perfect

prompt.zh: 如果你只能被誤會一種，你比較能接受哪一種？
prompt.en: If you had to be misunderstood in one way, which could you accept most?

prompt.zh: 如果未來的你只能寄回一句提醒，你希望他提醒什麼？
prompt.en: If your future self could send back only one reminder, what should it be?

options.en: Do not mistake fear for rationality
Do not mistake busyness for progress
Do not mistake habit for liking something

prompt.zh: 如果旅途中突然多出半天空檔，你會怎麼用？
prompt.en: If half a free day suddenly opened up during a trip, how would you use it?

options.en: Fill it with one more attraction
Sit in one place for a long time
Wander and see where you end up

prompt.zh: 如果這場聚會其實是一個秘密實驗，研究主題最可能是什麼？
prompt.en: If this hangout were actually a secret experiment, what would it most likely study?

options.zh: 人類如何被一句話帶偏
options.en: How humans get steered by one sentence

options.zh: 大家多快會假裝有共識
options.en: How quickly people pretend to agree

options.zh: 誰最會把尷尬變成笑點
options.en: Who is best at turning awkwardness into a joke

prompt.zh: 如果你想在遊戲裡看起來最無辜，你會怎麼做？
prompt.en: If you wanted to look the most innocent in the game, what would you do?

options.en: Throw the question back to everyone

options.zh: 用很真誠的語氣講廢話
options.en: Say nonsense in a very sincere tone
